scope: Exploratory retrospective comparison of official Census 2023 main-series national resident population projections with fixed later estimates; separate from WPP.
universe: National resident population of 50 states and District of Columbia; July 1; main series; total population.

units.projection: thousands of persons; multiply raw numeric Decimal by 1000
units.reference: persons; validate table metadata before extraction
units.rounding: Preserve raw stored decimal precision. Do not infer numeric precision from Excel display formatting.

metrics_scope: Per target, projection and both baselines; descriptive mean absolute error across the two primary targets. Horizons share one origin and are dependent. Sensitivity stays separate.
base_decomposition_limit: Algebraic base difference includes revision and any projection-table precision effects; not causal attribution.
limitations: Retrieved current historical files, not attested first-day bytes.
Census estimates are revisable reference estimates, not independent true population.
Prior research informed this adapted retrospective design; no confirmatory preregistration claim.
Two dependent horizons do not establish general skill.
No scenario selection, tuning, calibration, significance test, probabilities, own forecast issuance or WPP harmonization.
cell_mapping_validation: Coordinates observed from raw XML labels. Runner must verify workbook sheet relationship, labels, units, uniqueness and input hashes; coordinates alone are insufficient.

arithmetic.reporting: Decimal strings, no intermediate integer rounding; signed percentage error, not proportion.

missing_policy: Abort on missing, duplicate, nonfinite, nonpositive or unexpected source cells, dates, metadata, input hashes, units or sheet relationships. No imputation or substitutions.
selection_policy: Only main-series total national resident population; no alternative migration scenarios or later target years.
